label: September 21–27, 2026
intro: Chocolate fingers, drum beats, and science thrills — pack this week full of hands-on adventures for Thor!
weekday_note: Tuesday morning English planetarium show is the pick of the weekdays this week.

activities.title: Bean to Bar Chocolate Workshop
activities.time: Various sessions — check and book online
activities.why: Thor loved making chocolate! This hands-on bean-to-bar experience walks through the whole chocolate process — tasting included.
activities.tip: Book via Tripadvisor or Viator for confirmed slots. Minimum age is usually 6 — double-check when booking.

activities.title: Kids Pottery at Little Clay Room (Ekkamai)
activities.why: Thor's building & making instincts shine in clay — wheel throwing for age 5+, with patient instructors.
activities.tip: Little Clay Room is a beautiful, calm studio — great photos too. Book a few days ahead.

activities.title: Ice Skating at The Rink Central World
activities.location: The Rink, Central World (BTS Chit Lom)
activities.price: 350 THB weekday / 450 THB weekend (skate rental included)
activities.why: Bangkok's premier ice rink — practice penguins for support, staff always circling to help little ones.
activities.tip: Go in the morning before it gets crowded. Pair with lunch upstairs at Central World.

activities.title: Drum Trial Lesson at Rockademy
activities.why: Thor is a drumming fan — try a proper drum kit in a real music school. Rockademy specialises in performance-based learning for kids.
activities.tip: Ask for a 'taster' session designed for first-timers. Kids this age often LOVE it.

activities.title: National Science Museum Day Trip (Rangsit)
activities.location: National Science Museum, Khlong Luang, Pathum Thani (~45 min from Bangkok)
activities.why: Thailand's largest hands-on science museum — multiple buildings covering tech, natural history, and engineering. Amazing for a curious builder like Thor.
activities.tip: Take a Grab car (~350 THB each way) or drive. Bring snacks — the on-site cafe is small. Allow at least 3 hours.
